covers: D1: verify() and its helpers (host python, venv python, stamp want/file), ported from bootstrap.sh :76-124 and :187-248; findings as {code, text}; text verbatim.

D2: apply(), ported from bootstrap.sh :250-343: --clear rebuild for half-built or interpreter-gone venvs, mkdir of the parent, apt python3-venv only when launch.elevation() is ok, editable install, stamp last, then verify().

D3: report(findings), ported from bootstrap.sh :355-395: preflight.json under ~/.cairn/logs (HOME-relative, so a scratch HOME isolates it), the text for --append-system-prompt, one boot-log line per decision at ~/.cairn/logs/boot/floor.log.
D4: main(argv) as the CLI: verify|apply|report print JSON, exit 0 when no findings, 1 otherwise, 2 for a bad verb; `if __name__ == '__main__'` calls it
D5: the red-first proof, its seal, and the charter's invoke line naming floor.py
